name: Loamline
summary: A mountain bike clothing shop with a shoppable trail film, a size finder, filters, bag and checkout
about: A complete online shop for trail riding clothing and protection, in pale stone, rust and ink. The home page opens on a three-chapter trail film that crossfades with a slow zoom and a scrubber, and shows the kit worn in each shot. A fit finder turns height, reach, build and riding style into a size, draws it on a rider and marks it on every product page. Filters, galleries, reviews, a bag with promo codes, a checked checkout, an account and a journal all work.
how: On the home page, drag the film scrubber or pause it; the card in the corner adds the kit from each shot to your bag
Open Shop, Women, Men or New in, then filter by category, rider, riding style, size and sale, search, and sort
On a product, pick a colour (the drawn colour plate changes) and a size, then add it; hover the photo to zoom
Move the fit finder sliders for height and reach, choose build and riding style, and save your size
In the bag change quantities, remove a line with undo and try the code LOAM15, then fill in the checkout form
Sign in with any email and an 8-character password to see orders, wishlist and fit; reset the demo data in Settings or the footer
Press Ctrl+K to search products, pages and stories; Esc closes every drawer and dialog
